# Decisions in force

Accepted and not superseded, as of the last `deno task gen`.

## [ADR-0001](ADR-0001-replace-xero-with-in-house-ledger.md) — Replace Xero with an in-house ledger

**Contexts:** ledger, billing, banking, tax · **Decided:** 2026-08-08

> **In the context of** owning the order-to-invoice path but renting the ledger, **facing** a tracking-dimension defect that Xero silently absorbs and a costing model Xero cannot express, **we decided** to build the general ledger in-house, **to achieve** dimensional postings that cannot be null and a labour-absorption model we control, **accepting** that a large amount of unglamorous accounting surface area becomes ours to build and keep correct.

## [ADR-0002](ADR-0002-plaid-bank-feed.md) — Bank feed sourced from Plaid, single Chase account

**Contexts:** banking, ledger · **Decided:** 2026-08-08

> **In the context of** needing bank transactions now that Xero's feed goes away, **facing** one bank and one account, **we decided** to source the feed from Plaid, **to achieve** a working feed without a bank-specific integration, **accepting** that Plaid's transaction model is a consumer-fintech model, not an accounting bank feed.

## [ADR-0003](ADR-0003-mongodb-documents-tigerbeetle-ledger.md) — MongoDB for documents and masterfiles; TigerBeetle for the ledger

**Contexts:** ledger, ordering, billing · **Decided:** 2026-08-08

> **In the context of** replacing Firestore, **facing** two genuinely different storage problems — nested mutable business documents and an immutable balance-bearing ledger — **we decided** to use MongoDB for documents and TigerBeetle for the ledger, **to achieve** a ledger with enforced double-entry and real throughput alongside a document store that fits the order shape, **accepting** a two-store commit problem that has to be specified formally.

## [ADR-0004](ADR-0004-retain-deno-hono-typescript.md) — Retain Deno/Hono and TypeScript

**Contexts:** ledger, ordering, billing · **Decided:** 2026-08-08

> **In the context of** a greenfield rebuild that invites a stack change, **facing** a working Deno/Hono API and a one-person team, **we decided** to keep Deno, Hono and TypeScript, **to achieve** continuity of tooling and shared types with the clients, **accepting** that the TigerBeetle client may not load cleanly under Deno.

## [ADR-0005](ADR-0005-retain-solidjs-clients.md) — Retain SolidJS clients

**Contexts:** ordering, fulfillment · **Decided:** 2026-08-08

> **In the context of** rebuilding the API underneath the operator UI, **facing** a working SolidJS manager app, **we decided** to keep SolidJS, **to achieve** reuse of the existing client and its component work, **accepting** that the reactive data layer must be rebuilt regardless because Firestore's real-time listeners go away.

## [ADR-0006](ADR-0006-duckdb-over-parquet-read-side.md) — DuckDB over Parquet as the read side

**Contexts:** ledger, banking · **Decided:** 2026-08-08

> **In the context of** needing analytical reporting over the ledger, **facing** a transactional store that cannot answer period questions by accounting date, **we decided** to build the read side as DuckDB over Parquet, **to achieve** fast dimensional reporting and a durable audit artifact per period, **accepting** that reporting truth and balance truth now live in different systems.

## [ADR-0007](ADR-0007-replace-asset-accountant.md) — Replace asset.accountant; dual GAAP/tax basis in scope

**Contexts:** fixed-assets, tax, ledger · **Decided:** 2026-08-08

> **In the context of** building our own ledger, **facing** a separate hosted tool holding the asset register, **we decided** to bring fixed assets in-house with both GAAP and tax basis, **to achieve** depreciation postings that originate in the same ledger as everything else and a reportable deferred difference, **accepting** a genuinely intricate tax-depreciation rules problem.
